issues: Integrity: no problems found. There is no file or network access, no pasted answers and no use of test labels. The model is fit only on train_smiles/train_y, and the seed is passed to random_state.

BAG_FRACTION has no effect. LightGBM does not recognise 'bag_fraction': the parameter is 'bagging_fraction', with aliases subsample and sub_row. LightGBM either ignores it or only warns, and verbosity=-1 hides the warning. Even with the right name, row bagging only turns on when bagging_freq > 0, and it defaults to 0. So this setting is dead and no bagging happens. This is cosmetic and does not make the result meaningless. Remove it, or set subsample with subsample_freq=1, to match the 'simpler is better' rule.

Minor: feature_fraction is an alias of colsample_bytree, so it works, but using the sklearn-API name would be clearer. The new constructor lines are indented inconsistently, and the first one has trailing whitespace.

Only 1 candidate run. With z near 10 that is enough to accept, but a replicate would confirm the size of the gain. A drop from 0.7169 to 0.6661 is large but believable when going from ExtraTrees to gradient boosting on Morgan bits.
z checks out: diff = 0.7169 - 0.6661 = 0.0508; SE = 0.0042*sqrt(1/1 + 1/2) = 0.005144; z = 9.875, which matches the harness. Using the single-run sd alone would give z ≈ 12.1.
